articles.summary: Are you captivated by the wonders of atoms, molecules, and chemical reactions? If so, a chemistry degree could be an excellent match for your interests and career goals. But, you might be asking, what can you do with a chemistry degree?
articles.title: What Can You Do With a Chemistry Degree?

articles.summary: You’re faced with a daunting new assignment: write an essay. But you have no idea what to write about. The blank page stares back at you, and you can’t figure out how to start. How do you brainstorm and find good essay ideas?
articles.title: How to Brainstorm for an Essay
